name: Lieke Vermeer
bio:
Lieke's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for speed and a knack for tinkering. Growing up near Zandvoort, she spent countless hours watching races, dreaming of contributing to the sport. After earning her engineering degree from Delft University of Technology, she joined a smaller racing team, quickly proving her worth through innovative problem-solving and a meticulous approach to data analysis.

At EVO Racing Team, Lieke excels at optimizing car performance through detailed simulations and trackside adjustments. She is known for her ability to identify marginal gains and translate complex data into actionable strategies for the drivers. Her visionary approach to engineering, combined with her ambition to push boundaries, makes her a valuable asset to the team. Lieke believes that the key to success lies in a deep understanding of the car's dynamics and a constant pursuit of improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical braid
physical.description: Lieke has a serious expression and a focused gaze that reflects her analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even when not at the track
Insists on using a specific brand of notebook for her calculations
Has a habit of muttering equations under her breath when deep in thought
